Women's Monthly Social Ride at Coler

Bentonville, AR · Mountain bike · Social

Women / trans / femmeBeginner friendly

Women's Monthly Social Ride at Coler is a mountain bike and social group ride in Bentonville, AR. It rolls second Tuesday of the month at 5:30 pm from Coler Grove parking lot, Coler Mountain Bike Preserve. Pace: beginner-friendly, supportive group.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: beginner-friendly, supportive group.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Women's Monthly Social Ride at Coler group ride

A monthly mountain bike social led by an instructor and guide at Coler. It is beginner-friendly and open to all women who want to ride with others in a supportive group. RSVP is on the event page.
